Hi Camilla,I hope all is well with you. My apologies for not getting back to you sooner. Thank you again for sharing the details about the gamification feature. Here’s a breakdown of how we can possibly implement what you’ve described:Baseline Survey:We will ensure that the baseline survey is highly incentivized and that all subsequent activities require its completion. I have verified the triggering logics and can confirm that this dependency is correctly set up.Daily/Weekly Surveys:We understand the need to promote and reward consistent survey completion across different groups (treatment, control, observation) despite their varying study periods. We have 3 options here: We can custom implement a flexible reward system that incentivizes participants based on their specific group requirements while still providing rewards for those who may not complete all the Daily/Weekly surveys. However, this option will incur additional costs. We can duplicate the surveys for each group and assign different point values to them. However, this approach might complicate things and increase the likelihood of errors. We recommend keeping it simple: Implement a reward system that incentivizes participants to complete at least 75% of the minimum number of available Daily/Weekly surveys, which is approximately 26, regardless of their group. Exit Survey: We will ensure that the exit survey carries a significant reward weight. We will also ensure that completion of this survey is essential for finishing the gamification process. Regarding the different study periods, the gamification system can accommodate these variations. The score associated with the final badge will be based on the points from this survey, so it doesn’t matter when it is presented to each group. Please let me know if this approach and our recommendation for the Daily/Weekly surveys align with your goals. If so, we should be able to add the reward system to your study by October 22. Additionally, let me know if you would like to customize the badge names, logos, and promotional messages, or if you prefer to proceed with our default version.Looking forward to your feedback.Best,Sara On Friday, October 11, 2024 at 5:06:53 PM,
